findings.title: Returned OAuth callback target is not validated exactly before code exchange
findings.counterexample: A pending native attempt receives SDK success at otgd-local://oauth/callback-extra?state=<current-state>&code=<valid-current-code>. Android accepts its configured callback prefix. On iOS a custom callback with the admitted scheme and a different host/path is also accepted by the SDK session. AuthRequest parses only params/state; AuthManager ignores result.url, consumes the attempt and invokes exchange with the configured redirect_uri. This is a source-derived path, not a runtime/native exploit execution.
findings.impact: Fails specified exact callback target admission before credential exchange. Current PKCE, one-use code and high-entropy state still constrain exploitation; no arbitrary account takeover, credential theft, or defeated issuer redirect enforcement is claimed.
findings.required_correction: Parse and admit the actual returned successful URL against the exact selected compiled callback target before consume/exchange. Permit the documented successful code/state response query only; reject additional target/query ambiguity, fragment, duplicate fields and scheme/host/path/port/userinfo variants. Keep outgoing pins, state, PKCE and one-use guards.
findings.verification: Matching-state success at wrong host, path suffix, port, userinfo or malformed/missing return URL must refuse before token fetch/capability lookup/account activation; exact native/web callback still succeeds and replay/refresh/logout tests remain meaningful. Actual native OS browser evidence remains external.
findings.execution_status: Not executed by this read-only reviewer; frozen-source runtime probes prohibited
findings.minimal_reproduction_plan: Under PM-authorized test ownership after the frozen gate boundary: reuse the existing auth harness; return SDK success with current request.state, valid fixture code and url=otgd-local://oauth/callback-extra?code=<code>&state=<state>. Assert authorize rejects before fetch(token_endpoint), with capability lookup/account identity unchanged. Repeat iOS same-scheme wrong-host/path and exact matching callback positive. Do not execute in this read-only review.
